tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Daylight is poured Selby concrete; Night Shift is Newtown coal at 5 AM.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: Raised industrial surfaces: header bands, footers, image mats, the wall a card is pinned to. Never put `rust` body text on it (4.3:1 in Daylight); headings 24px+ only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and control borders on `ground` and `slab`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on `ground` and `slab`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and table dividers only. Carries no meaning, so it may sit below 3:1. Use `ink` for any border a person must see.

tokens.name: concrete
tokens.usage: Selby Concrete. Large decorative fields, photo placeholders, cover blocks. Never text.

tokens.name: coal
tokens.usage: Newtown Coal. The suit: primary button fill, full-bleed dark bands, the wordmark on light. Same deep black in both themes.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Bone white. Text and marks on `coal`, `rust` and `lining` fills, in both themes.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Jeppestown Rust. The one loud colour: links, the active state, sale and drop callouts, the wordmark on bone. Text on `ground` and `paper`.

tokens.name: on-rust
tokens.usage: Text on a `rust` fill. Bone in Daylight, coal in Night Shift where rust lightens.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Brass button. Ornament only: pick stitching, double rules, cuff-button discs, corner brackets, foil. As text only at 24px+ or for the italic flourish line. Reads at 7.9:1 on `coal`.

tokens.name: lining
tokens.usage: Lining green: the silk inset you only see when the jacket opens. Use sparingly for an inner detail, a member tier, a quiet secondary accent. Bone text on it in Daylight.

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: Stamp ink. Status stamps only (SOLD, RESERVED). Always carries the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Archive card stock and garment tags. Stays paper in both themes because the cards are physical objects.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `paper`, both themes.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and ruled lines on `paper`, both themes (6.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: paper-accent
tokens.usage: Rust as it is printed on `paper`, both themes: batch numbers, the date column.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. Coal in Daylight, brass in Night Shift; 3:1 or better on every surface.

groups.name: Grace
groups.note: Bodoni Moda: the tailoring. High contrast, sharp serifs, italic for the flourish. Headlines and editorial moments.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per page. Campaign lines and Substack titles.

styles.name: flourish
styles.sample: restored by hand, worn with intent
styles.usage: The italic grace note under a heading, pull quotes, signatures. Brass or ink.

groups.name: Grit
groups.note: Big Shoulders Stencil: the warehouse wall and the shipping crate. Always uppercase.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark and drop numbers. Nothing else at this size.

styles.name: stencil-label
styles.usage: Drop names, section markers, packaging, signage.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Archivo: sturdy workshop grotesk for everything practical.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: He left home at 4 AM to mix dough in a bakery, dressed like he owned the city.
styles.usage: Essay intros and product story openers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Heavy 1970s worsted, sourced at Dunusa on Bree Street, relined in green silk.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Dry clean only. Steam, never iron the lapel.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headings and on spec rows.

groups.name: Record
groups.note: Courier Prime: the typewriter on the archive card. Facts only.

styles.name: record
styles.usage: Batch numbers, dates, measurements, prices, card entries.

styles.name: record-sm
styles.usage: Tag fine print and plate numbers.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Think of the bigger steps as seam allowance: generous margins are what make cheap cloth look expensive.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Stitch gaps, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and stamps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between label and value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, cover inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on phone.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room, the seam allowance around a campaign image.

radius.note: Sharp by default, like a pressed lapel. Round only where the object is round.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything by default: cards, buttons, images, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Woven tags and stamps, which have softened corners in real life.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Cuff-button discs and the round stamp only.

shadow.note: One shadow: paper resting on concrete. No glows.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: Archive cards, tags and plates laid on a surface.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules, card ruling, double-rule lines.

tokens.name: stroke-stitch
tokens.usage: Pick-stitch dashes.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Stencil frames and the top bar of a garment tag.
